scope: Synthetic, owned local experiments for Bug46 metadata preservation and Bug47 ancestor-swap containment, plus an unqualified local GitHub Actions gate stub. This is not an installed-package, cross-principal, or release qualification result.

native_primitive.classification: Experimental C fixture only; not an mdkg runtime dependency or production patch.

macos.environment: macOS 26.4 arm64, Node v26.0.0; owned temporary fixtures

baseline.node_copy_file_acl: A source 0644 file with a named nobody deny-read ACL copied to 0644 without that ACL.
baseline.injected_ancestor_swap: After validation and before sink use, read returned outside bytes, append modified an outside sentinel, and remove deleted an outside sentinel. The originally contained item remained inside the moved directory.
baseline.qualification: Deterministic monkeypatched sink interleaving, not an independently timed cross-process exploit.

native_primitive.descriptor_relative_result: Held O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW directory descriptors plus openat/renameat/unlinkat kept read, create, append, replacement, and removal inside the original directory after its pathname was replaced with a symlink; outside sentinel unchanged.
native_primitive.metadata_result: fstat/fchown/fchmod/acl_get_fd/acl_set_fd established equal owner, group, mode, and ACL before content write in 0644 named-ACL and 0600 no-ACL fixtures. The 0600 control used a differing group.

ubuntu.environment: Isolated local Lima Apple VZ VM, Ubuntu 24.04.4 aarch64, ext4, no host mounts; guest user uid 501
ubuntu.descriptor_relative_result: The same five operations stayed inside the held directory after an ancestor symlink swap; outside sentinel unchanged.
ubuntu.metadata_result: A 0644 POSIX ACL fixture with u:nobody:--- and a 0600 no-extra-ACL fixture matched mode, owner, group, and ACL before write.
ubuntu.custody: Only the disposable guest received gcc, libacl1-dev, and acl packages. The scoped VM was stopped and deleted after results were captured; the pre-existing unrelated Lima instance was untouched. The exact owned host scratch tree was removed after the probe sources were retained in this artifact directory.

ci_stub.behavior: Only an explicitly dispatched full tier would schedule Ubuntu 24.04 x64/ARM64 stub jobs; each exits 1. The aggregate requires their success. No hosted run was dispatched or credited.

assessment.bug_46: Still blocked. Node copyFile mode behavior does not establish ACL or ownership preservation. A complete remedy must preserve applicable metadata before sensitive bytes and handle failures safely across both atomic writers and callers.
assessment.bug_47: Still blocked. Descriptor-relative OS primitives are feasible on the two tested local ARM64 platforms, but mdkg has no qualified interface to them. All path sinks, callback-based callers, packaging, stale-plan behavior, and failure handling still require implementation and review.
assessment.test_487: Unqualified. One local Ubuntu ARM64 primitive experiment does not substitute for exact installed-artifact macOS/Linux x64/ARM64 qualification.
assessment.release: Goal86 and Goal85 acceptance gates unchanged; 0.6.0 is NOT_READY and unpublished.

unverified: No production mdkg filesystem fix, native addon or helper protocol.
No Linux x64 or other supported-runtime installed candidate test.
No cross-principal attack, ACL/ownership failure injection, reparse/symlink matrix, or complete callback sink audit.
No independent security diff review, full release ladder, final artifact seal, hosted GitHub Actions run, remote Git, provider, deployment, or publication action.
next_decision: Choose and authorize the bounded native interface/distribution design, or explicitly revise the security/release scope. No silent waiver or mode-only/path-recheck substitute is justified by these probes.
